summary: Problem: selected task filters disappear when a member opens a task and then returns to the task list. Solution: store the selected type and difficulty in the page URL and browser session. Expected impact: contributors can compare several tasks without repeatedly selecting the same filters. Scope: task portal filter state only. I reproduced this behavior on desktop Chrome and recorded the workflow.
